scripts.check:fast: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run check-types
scripts.verify: bun run check:fast && bun run test && bun run --filter '@dodecagon/server' build && bun run --filter '@dodecagon/server' test:bundle
scripts.signoff:local: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run verify && bun run --filter '@dodecagon/e2e' test:e2e:shards && gh signoff build e2e
scripts.magic: bun run format && bun run check-types && bun run lint
